newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PM calls news conference for 1200 gmt.
newsitem.headline: Czech PM calls news conference for 1200 gmt.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus has called a news conference for 2 p.m. (1200 GMT) on Friday to make an important statement, his office said.

"Today at 2 p.m. in the government building will take place an extraordinary press conference of the prime minister Vaclav Klaus at which he will make an important statement," said the three-line statement by his spokesman Ivo Strejcek.
Strejcek told Reuters that he did not have any more details on on the news conference.

Klaus has been under intense pressure over the past two weeks amid a sharp downturn in the economy and heavy pressure on the Czech crown, culminating in the central bank being forced to float the currency earlier this week.
Klaus' three-party centre-right coalition unveiled an austerity programme on Wednesday aimed at stabilising the economy, and shuffled four seats in the cabinet.

Earlier on Friday, opposition Social Democrat leader Milos Zeman called for a vote of no confidence to be put forward in the July 1 session of parliament. The crown weakened shaply after Zeman's statement.
